description: 本課集中處理 encounter = meet or find unexpectedly / by chance 的義項。 不把 encounter difficulties = face, encounter resistance = meet with, 或 encounter a situation = experience 混入主線。

words.example: I came across an old photograph while clearing the cupboard.
words.exampleZh: 我整理櫥櫃時偶然發現了一張舊照片。

exercises.zh: 我瀏覽圖書館目錄時偶然看到一篇有趣文章。
exercises.upgrade: A. Come across · 偶然遇見；偶然發現

options.explanation: Come across ✓ — meet or find someone or something unexpectedly。這句的關鍵是 an accidental discovery in an ordinary context。因此 Come across 最準確保留 encounter 在『偶然遇到／發現』這個義項。
Run into — meet someone unexpectedly in an everyday situation。最自然於偶遇『人』，而不是文件、地點或物件的偶然發現。
Discover — find something previously unknown。強調發現新事物，但不一定表示『偶然』，所以少了 chance element。
Meet — come together with someone, possibly by arrangement。可以是預先安排的見面，因此不足以表達 unexpected encounter。
Face — confront a difficulty or situation。表示面對問題／困難，屬 encounter 的另一義項，不是本課的偶遇 sense。
Experience — undergo or live through something。表示經歷事件／情況，屬 encounter 的另一義項。

Chance upon ✓ — find or meet something unexpectedly in a more literary style。這句的關鍵是 literary discovery by chance。因此 Chance upon 最準確保留 encounter 在『偶然遇到／發現』這個義項。
Come across — meet or find someone or something unexpectedly。是很自然的廣義替代，但如果題目明確要測『偶遇人』『文學敘事』『完全意外撞見』，另有更精準詞。
Meet — come together with someone, possibly by arrangement。可以是預先安排的見面，因此不足以表達 unexpected encounter。
Find — locate or obtain something, deliberately or accidentally。可以是刻意搜尋後找到，因此沒有保留 by chance 的意思。
Experience — undergo or live through something。表示經歷事件／情況，屬 encounter 的另一義項。

exercises.original: She encountered an old acquaintance at a conference abroad.
exercises.zh: 她在海外會議上偶然碰到一位舊相識。

exercises.upgrade: D. Discover unexpectedly · 意外發現；出乎意料地發現

options.explanation: Find by chance — discover something unintentionally rather than through a deliberate search。適合物件／資料的偶然發現；遇到人時通常不如 run into / come across 自然。
Come across — meet or find someone or something unexpectedly。是很自然的廣義替代，但如果題目明確要測『偶遇人』『文學敘事』『完全意外撞見』，另有更精準詞。
Meet — come together with someone, possibly by arrangement。可以是預先安排的見面，因此不足以表達 unexpected encounter。
Discover unexpectedly ✓ — find something without expecting to find it。這句的關鍵是 the focus is unexpected discovery of a feature。因此 Discover unexpectedly 最準確保留 encounter 在『偶然遇到／發現』這個義項。
Face — confront a difficulty or situation。表示面對問題／困難，屬 encounter 的另一義項，不是本課的偶遇 sense。
Experience — undergo or live through something。表示經歷事件／情況，屬 encounter 的另一義項。

exercises.original: Researchers encountered evidence of an earlier settlement beneath the site.
exercises.zh: 研究人員意外發現該地點下方有更早期聚落的證據。

falseSynonyms.zh: 見面 ≠ encounter meet 可以是事先安排；encounter 在本課義項強調偶然。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A meeting may be planned.

falseSynonyms.zh: 找到 ≠ encounter find 不一定偶然，也可經過刻意搜尋。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Finding need not be accidental.

falseSynonyms.zh: 發現 ≠ encounter discover 強調新發現，不一定帶偶遇或偶然性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Discovery is not always chance-based.

falseSynonyms.zh: 面對 ≠ 本課 encounter face 對應 encounter = confront a difficulty 的另一義項。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Face belongs to a different sense.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經歷 ≠ 本課 encounter experience 對應 encounter = undergo a situation 的另一義項。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Experience belongs to a different sense.

falseSynonyms.zh: 主要用於偶遇人 run into 也可表示遇到問題，但與本課 discovery sense 不完全相同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Run into is conversational and context-sensitive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偶然性更強 比普通 encounter 更有意外撞見的感覺。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is more vivid and accidental.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形陷阱 注意原形、過去式／過去分詞和 -ing 形式。
